title: Free Water Deficit
sources: Rose BD, Post TW. Clinical Physiology of Acid-Base and Electrolyte Disorders, 5th ed.
Adrogué HJ, Madias NE. N Engl J Med 2000;342:1493-9 (rate-of-correction guidance)

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: TBW-fraction map and deficit formula confirmed. Primary citation changed to the standard textbook form (the deficit equation is not the headline equation of the Adrogué-Madias paper, which gives Δ[Na] per litre of infusate).

purpose: Water needed to correct hypernatremia. Correct slowly — no more than 8-10 mEq/L per 24 h to avoid osmotic demyelination.

interpretation.label: Replace this volume plus ongoing losses. Recheck sodium every 4-6 h; target a fall of ≤ 8-10 mmol/L per 24 h.

notes: The select value maps to the TBW fraction: 0.6 / 0.5 / 0.45. This estimates the water deficit only — it does not account for ongoing insensible or urinary losses.
